Comment: Channel models for Train_PCA_Basis.py. Delays in ns, powers in dB. Each class is trained on the average correlation of its profiles; the equalizer picks the class per packet from the measured delay spread (last delay with channel energy, in 20 MHz samples).
TimingJitter_comment: training includes a uniform timing error of +/- this many samples (packet-detector timing, fractional delays)
UniformFloor_comment: power spread evenly over 0..MaxDelay of each class, relative to the profile power; keeps the basis from collapsing onto the exact tap delays of the models
EnergyKept_comment: rank r = smallest number of principal components holding this fraction of the pilot correlation energy
